cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Tell Me Why
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal the motive behind a choice by offering small pieces of your own truth as bait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I once hid an invitation because I felt left out. Why hide mine? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I nearly skipped your birthday when you invited Leah. Is this about being alone?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's about you liking her more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I counted your photos with her after that party. Did you hide mine to make me choose you?

mechanism: A manages resolving evening plans and offers company while releasing increasingly embarrassing jealousy truths to draw out why B hid an invitation.
confusable: Unlike demanding B hurt first, A supplies A own truth first as bait; borrowed authority accommodates B fear of being left while pursuing the motive.
comparison: Relational jealousy and a concealed invitation differ from professional embarrassment behind an avoided station route.
seedUse: D136-a hidden invitation, Leah and counted photos; S02-a adjusts the plans to retain B engagement.
